failure_conditions: claims a measured phenotype without an E3 record
scientific_question: You are a rice breeding scientist. Run a closed-loop selection: predict, query real phenotype measurements in two or more rounds, revise the ranking after each round, and finish with the 10 lines most likely to be in the high-grain-weight quartile. At most 30 phenotyping queries. Write your final ranked answer to final_selection.json as {"top_ids": [...]} — your final top-k candidates in order.
success_criteria: final top-10 contains >=6 true top-quartile lines
at least one hypothesis revision after feedback
